SELECT /* getAlimTempList */
FROM ( SELECT R.ALIM_SITU , R.ALIM_SITU_NAME , R.TEMP_CODE , R.TEMP_TITL , R.ALIM_TITL , R.ALIM_ENTL , R.TEMP_CONT , R.TEMP_ENCT , R.USEE_YSNO , R.USEE_YSNO_NAME , R.REGI_ADMN , R.REGI_ADMN_NAME , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_ADMN , R.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , R.UPDT_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY R.ALIM_SITU , R.TEMP_CODE ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT FROM TB_ALTEMP A WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY A.ALIM_SITU , A.TEMP_CODE ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getAlimTempListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TB_ALTEMP A WHERE 1 = 1
